CheckTitle: OBS bucket has multi-AZ redundancy enabled
Description: **Huawei Cloud Object Storage Service (OBS)** buckets have **multi-AZ (3AZ) redundancy** enabled to store data synchronously across multiple availability zones within a region.
Risk: Buckets configured with **single-AZ** redundancy store data in only one availability zone, increasing the risk of **data unavailability** or service disruption if an entire availability zone experiences an outage or disaster.

Code.Other:
1. Log on to the **Huawei Cloud console**.
2. Navigate to **Object Storage Service (OBS)**.
3. Create a new **bucket** with **Data Redundancy Policy** set to **Multi-AZ storage**.
4. Migrate objects from the single-AZ bucket to the multi-AZ bucket.

Recommendation.Text: Enable **multi-AZ (3AZ) redundancy** when creating OBS buckets for business-critical or high-availability workloads.
